topics.text: Close to Moganshan National Park, located deep in the village, quiet, with a small stream at the door, some rooms have balconies, and the top-floor public terrace can enjoy sunrises and sunsets
The boss's family is enthusiastic, helps buy scenic spot tickets, finds shuttle buses, breakfast is rich, and bedding is changed per guest with disinfectant used
There is a parking lot, a swimming pool at the door, bathroom with dry-wet separation, spacious rooms and complete facilities
Breakfast combines Chinese and Western styles, dishes are fresh, vegetables are grown by themselves, dishes are delicious, and there is an Italian coffee machine

address: No. 25, Xiwuli, Houwu Village, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: You won’t find a nicer and more friendly host family in China. Great place to stay. Clean rooms. Good food. Close to the Moganshan national park. Highly recommend it.
comments.author: Mikkel Eisenhardt

comments.quote: The guesthouse was very nice, clean and hygienic, the landlady was warm and hospitable, and the food was delicious. I'll definitely come back next time.
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: I stayed for two days and here's my honest review—I'm not a shill! Accommodation Experience: This guesthouse isn't a luxury hotel, but it has a really homey feel. We stayed in a balcony room, and cleanliness was the bare minimum....
comments.author: Guest User
